test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A boy bought some toffee at the rate of 15 toffees for Rs. 3 and sold all of them at the rate of 3 toffee for Rs. 2. Find the gain or loss.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Cost price of some toffee at the rate of 15 toffees = Rs. 3 

Selling price of some toffee at the rate of 3 toffee = Rs. 2 

**FORMULA USED:**

Gain percent = (Gain/C.P.) × 100 

Gain = (S.P. - C.-P.)

Where, S.P. = Selling Price C.P.= Cost price.

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume the person buys 45 toffees 

(you can assume any number but for the sake of calculation, we have taken L.C.M of 15 and 3)

⇒ C.P. of 15 toffees = Rs. 3

⇒ C.P. of 45 toffees = ( 3/15) × 45 = Rs. 9

⇒ S.P. of 3 toffee = Rs. 2

⇒ S.P. of 45 toffees = (2/3) × 45 = Rs. 30

⇒ Gain = (S.P. - C.P.) = (30 - 9 ) = Rs. 21

⇒ Gain% = (Gain/C.P.) × 100 = (21/ 9) × 100 = 700/3 = 233 (1)/(3)% gain

**Hence, gain% is 233(1)/(3)%.**
